title: A Technical Study of the 1531 Huexotzinco Codex Using Macroscopic Examination and Multimodal Imaging
lineage: Brief paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: Conservators identify four amate and four maguey supports in the 1531 codex and describe Mesoamerican beaten-fibre sheets using historical accounts. Their noninvasive examination does not identify specific sheet makers or prove how every sheet was prepared.
